2438-2486-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-2486-4694-7306.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

967-3809-6495-7087-7824.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-3809-6495-7087-7824.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2866-4808-4986-8095.description:
Cast Black Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Black Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2921-3197-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

676-1809-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1809-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1809-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1809-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1809-1987-3110.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-3110.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-3110.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2724-3080-5299-7715.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-3738-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2292-3738-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grinding Station

661-1651-2073-3698--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning a noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the artifact enters, Grinding Station and Sculpting Steel trigger, untapping themselves.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Sculpting Steel and the noncreature artifact returned in step 1, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the noncreature artifact, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

969-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
969-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-4373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-1409-5419.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-4730.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sparring Mummy.
When Sparring Mummy enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

779-3446-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4231-4321-4772-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
4231-4321-4772-5777.notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

1274-2086-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

222-527-4785-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3765-4910-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-4910-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-4910-6102.description:
Activate Alchemist's Refuge by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 2, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

3443-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3443-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1429-5231-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-5231-5958.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {R}.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Repeat.

1462-2929-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-4872-5163.notablePrerequisites: Roon does not have summoning sickness.
2493-4872-5163.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Roon by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Archaeomancer until the beginning of your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Roon triggers, returning Archaeomancer from exile to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, putting Time Warp into your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

678-1082-4465.description:
Cast Basal Sliver by paying {2}{B}.
Basal Sliver enters the battlefield triggering Dual Nature, creating a token copy of Basal Sliver.
Activate the token Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate the Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Dual Nature and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, exiling all creatures named Basal Sliver.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Basal Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

231-3200-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
231-3200-4377-4423.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at a random card in target player's hand and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, returning Urza's Bauble from graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Urza's Bauble triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
